questions.question: How did Yorozu first meet Sukuna?
questions.subject: Yorozu/Synopsis

answer.item: She spotted Sukuna, who had been invited as an idol for worship. Recognizing his imposing strength, Yorozu approached and embraced him, thinking he was lonely because of it.

questions.question: What became of Yorozu's cursed object after her death?
questions.subject: Yorozu/Synopsis

answer.item: Her cursed object was eventually ingested by Tsumiki Fushiguro, who fell into deep slumber after being marked by Kenjaku

questions.question: How did Yorozu come to possess Tsumiki's body?
questions.subject: Yorozu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yorozu was incarnated through the body of Tsumiki after Kenjaku remotely altered the latter's soul using Idle Transfiguration, which awakened her and gave her strength to serve as Yorozu's vessel

questions.question: Why did Yorozu want to kill Sukuna during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Yorozu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yorozu intended to kill Sukuna to profess her love for him
